item.title: Musashi: Motorola 680x0 emulator written in C
item.description:
📝 ADDING PROPER INTERRUPT HANDLING: -------------------------------- The interrupt handling in the basic configuration doesn't emulate the interrupt acknowledge phase of the CPU and automatically clears an interrupt request during interrupt processing. To add proper interrupt handling: - In m68kconf. h, set M68K_INT_ACK_CALLBACK(A) to your interrupt acknowledge routine - Your interrupt acknowledge routine must return an interrupt vector, M68K_INT_ACK_AUTOVECTOR, or M68K_INT_ACK_SPURIOUS.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/kstenerud/Musashi

item.title: The virtual AmigaOS runtime (a.k.a. Wine for Amiga:)
SSDs, power loss protection and fsync latency
item.description:
📝 I don't think that InnoDB ever does an fsync after each write. For devices without power loss protection it is often true that writes are fast but fsync is slow. When fsync is slow then calling fsync more frequently in InnoDB will hurt performance.
🔗 Read more: http://smalldatum.blogspot.com/2026/01/ssds-power-loss-protection-and-fsync.html
